# jQStar

> HTML-first reactive framework for server-rendered applications, powered by jQuery.

Package: jquery-star@0.1.0
Corpus: jqstar-agent-content/3
Canonical site: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/

## Agent surfaces

- [Agent guide](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/agents/): Human-readable agent support, provenance, tools, limits, and reporting guidance.
- [LLM index](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/llms.txt): A short map of the approved jQStar corpus and canonical public pages.
- [Bounded full-text corpus](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/llms-full.txt): Reviewed guide text, component contracts, examples, and framework invariants.
- [Machine-readable agent index](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/jqstar-agent-index.json): The versioned corpus used by the website search and WebMCP tools.

## Documentation

- [jQStar framework](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/): What jQStar is, what stays on the server, and the boundaries of the current framework.
- [Introduction](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/): Install jquery-star, boot an application, use real jQuery beside reactive signals, and copy registry recipes.
- [Datastar integration](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/datastar/): Call backend actions and consume JSON, HTML, or Datastar SSE generated by the official SDK.
- [Core API](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/api/): Applications, named actions, backend actions, UI methods, scheduling, version, and lifecycle.
- [CSP expressions](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/csp/): The shipped jquery-star/csp installer, finite expression grammar, capability boundary, deterministic limits, server policy, diagnostics, and compatibility migrations.
- [Plugins](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/plugins/): Build transactional public plugins and verify packed-package rollback, use, rendering, observation, and cleanup behavior.
- [Turbo and htmx interoperability](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/interoperability/): Install the shipped Turbo and htmx lifecycle bridges and review their tested version boundaries, preservation, focus ownership, and limits.
- [jQuery ecosystem](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/ecosystem/): Reviewed package and migration boundaries for jQuery Core, Migrate, UI, Mobile, Sizzle, and QUnit.
- [jQuery UI coexistence and migration](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/ecosystem/jquery-ui/): Isolate application-owned jQuery UI regions and migrate them feature by feature to semantic HTML and native jQStar components.
- [jQuery Mobile migration](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/ecosystem/jquery-mobile/): Migrate archived jQuery Mobile applications route by route to server documents, semantic HTML, responsive CSS, jQuery 4, and bounded jQStar enhancement.
- [Testing](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/testing/): Use an explicit DOM realm, deterministic response queue, bounded flush, disposal reports, and runner-neutral conformance.
- [Components](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/components/): Native component semantics, data-jqs roots, data-part slots, state attributes, and source-owned recipes.
- [Dialog](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/components/dialog/): Native modal dialog markup, focus containment and return, lifecycle events, and named actions.
- [Dropdown](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/components/dropdown/): Menu-button markup with roving focus, typeahead, selection, and collision-aware positioning.
- [Tabs](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/components/tabs/): Keyboard-accessible tabs with stable values and automatic or manual activation.
- [Toast](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/components/toast/): Accessible non-modal notifications with timers, actions, focus, and swipe dismissal.
- [Component Lab](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/components/lab/): The exhaustive browser proof for registry recipes, composed blocks, backend requests, and Datastar streams.
- [Agent support](https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/agents/): Static discovery, versioned corpus provenance, optional read-only WebMCP tools, limits, and contract reporting.

## Required invariants

- jQStar is an HTML-first reactive framework for server-rendered applications. It uses the real jQuery instance and does not require a virtual DOM or client-side router. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/
- $ is real jQuery. A name such as $count is a reactive signal. These meanings are intentionally different. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/
- The explicit jquery-star/csp engine performs no dynamic code construction in its entry graph. It requires trusted markup and trusted installed extensions, is not a sandbox, and does not configure or replace the page policy for scripts, styles, network endpoints, jQuery plugins, or application code. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/csp/
- A component root uses data-jqs. Stable internal slots use data-part. Reflected state uses data-state or a documented component-specific data attribute. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/components/
- The application owns component markup and block code after jqstar add copies registry recipes into it. Generic behavior stays in the jquery-star package. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/
- Datastar SSE must be generated with @starfederation/datastar-sdk. Do not handwrite Datastar event strings. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/datastar/
- Server-rendered HTML remains authoritative. Use data-jqs-preserve only for a live root that must survive a patch, and use whenEnhanced() to wait for a complete patch commit. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/datastar/
- The testing harness requires a caller-owned same-realm Window, Document, and jQuery instance. Its bounded flush covers jQStar-owned work, queued fixtures, and registered finite tasks, not arbitrary timers or real-network idleness. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/testing/
- Turbo and htmx own requests, forms, history, focus, and DOM mutation. The shipped jquery-star/turbo and jquery-star/htmx bridges use the public render adapter only to release outgoing ownership, preserve exact approved identities, and enhance incoming roots. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/interoperability/
- jQStar components start with native HTML semantics and add only missing state and keyboard behavior. WebMCP does not replace semantic HTML, accessibility APIs, or JavaScript-disabled content. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/components/
- jQStar is independent. It provides migration paths from ordinary jQuery, jQuery UI, and jQuery Mobile without claiming to be an official successor or bundling those archived UI runtimes. Citation: https://ignibyte.github.io/jqstar/docs/ecosystem/

Use the machine-readable index for stable IDs and component contracts. Use the bounded full-text companion when a short index is not enough.
